title: SAM3 face masks lose the lips - document why threshold/refine_iterations cannot fix it, add MpiMaskFillHoles
description: SAM3 prompted 'face'/'head' returns a mask with the lips and teeth punched out; a composite then paints through the gap, and on video it flickers because it is frame-dependent. Neither obvious widget reaches it: threshold gates a detection SCORE, and refine_iterations cannot carve at all because _refine_mask unions the refined mask with the coarse one (comfy_extras/nodes_sam3.py:84), so refinement only ever adds. The hole is in the detector's own concept mask. Two outcomes: (1) docs/masking-sam3.md records the finding, and corrects its standing claim that detector masks come back clean; (2) MpiMaskFillHoles in the sibling node pack fills enclosed holes without touching the silhouette - carded there as MPI-7, node written and checked but deliberately NOT committed, synced, pinned or pushed this session.
